# MOE repository guidance

Read `AGENTS.md` for the repository's governance and safety boundaries. Use the pinned `engineering-clarity` skill at `.agents/skills/engineering-clarity/SKILL.md` when creating or reviewing technical prose. Read its references and `implementation/ecs-integration.md`; use `docs/glossary.md` for MOE concepts.

Preserve exact identifiers, schema values, source quotations, and raw evidence. Report `unknown` when results are unavailable and `not_run` only when non-execution is known. Never fabricate success or authority. Pass relevant guidance to each delegated writing task.

ECS is the MOE project's writing choice, not a mandatory dependency for other organizations. Existing MOE and organizational policy govern authority and acceptance. Skill presence does not prove activation; follow `evaluation/ecs/README.md` for runtime checks.
